tool_args.rationale: All pilot horizons are at or below 0.48, far short of the forecast horizon of 21.9. A slow component can look nearly linear in the pilots yet determine the sign and magnitude of the long-horizon response. The targeted probe tests that reversal directly.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-window rows constrain early gain but do not reliably separate the slow amplitude and time constant that govern the forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Every pilot row has zero spatial gradient, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable.
Finer sampling is less directly informative than a long-horizon measurement about whether and when the response reverses.
The pilots show rising positive gain but provide no evidence of recurring oscillations.
